name: filesystem_project_workflow_live
description: A real model drives a realistic build-and-verify session: write a program, run it through the shell, and report what it printed. Live counterpart of scripted_filesystem_project_workflow — the model chooses the tools, and the reported number reflects the real shell output.
input: Create a file adder.py that defines add(a, b) returning a + b, and prints add(19, 23) when run. Use the write_file tool.
user_turns: Now run adder.py with the shell tool and tell me the number it printed.
